# Implementation Plan: Repo-aware multi-repo plan splitter for ralph-orchestration (D-001, staged)
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"ralph-orchestration-multi-repo-single-job-support"} -->

*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph --from-brainstorm` on 2026-06-26. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-orchestration-multi-repo-single-job-support/plan.md`.*

## Overview

`/implement-with-ralph` scopes one job to ONE repo: `prd.json.repoDir` (single absolute path) + one worktree. A plan that must WRITE to two repos — e.g. the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule + the codexu wrapper, or (the dominant real case) the codex inner `codex-patched` crate + the codex wrapper docs — cannot be expressed as one Ralph job. The standing workaround is a manual lead-orchestrated 2-job split, shipped in dependency order. On 2026-06-09 prose-constraining a single member to "Job 1 only, do NOT do Job 2" caused a **codex member to HAND-ROLL the implementation** instead of driving the skill — the concrete failure this task exists to kill.

This plan builds the recommended brainstorm direction **D-001 (staged)**: a repo-aware plan-splitter/scaffolder with **lead-owned shipping**, reusing already-shipped primitives (`worktree-create.mjs --target-repo`, `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch --target-repo --job-dir`, `additionalDirs[]`). It is split into two increments so the hand-roll fix ships first and the irreversible cross-repo SHIP stays lead-gated:

- **Increment 1 (ship first, effort ~S):** a canonical per-repo job TEMPLATE + a `$namespaced` spawn-prompt CONVENTION + a tiny VALIDATOR (`src/validate-prd-scope.mjs`) that rejects a job seed whose plan/PRD writes to >1 repo. This alone eliminates the observed codex hand-roll.
- **Increment 2 (effort ~M, frequency-gate CONFIRMED — see Research Findings):** a `scaffold-multi-repo-jobs` skill that reads ONE plan + a machine-readable repo map and emits N scoped single-repo job dirs (via `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch` + per-repo `--target-repo` + `worktree-create.mjs`) plus a standalone, dependency-ordered SHIP-ORDER MANIFEST whose cross-repo ship gates are LEAD checkpoints, NOT automation.

It explicitly **REJECTS D-002** (automated cross-repo submodule-pointer bumps, multi-remote pushes, cross-repo rollback) — those remain the documented lead-owned `Multi-repo wrapper-to-submodule ship ceremony` in `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md`.

> **Target repo / worktree:** this is an `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule change (`plugins/ralph/`). The impl member must create a worktree INSIDE the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule at `D:/harness-efforts/codexu/ai-developer-toolkit/.worktrees/<task-id>` and use the two-commit submodule flow (commit in the submodule first, then the codexu pointer bump). Do NOT edit the installed plugin copy under `~/.copilot/installed-plugins/...`; that is a marketplace cache.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
Seeded from brainstorm: `.ralph/brainstorms/ralph-orchestration-multi-repo-single-job-support/selected-direction.md`.

The architecture already has most of the substrate; the gap is narrow and was explicitly flagged as "future scope". All paths below are relative to the plugin root `ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph/` unless noted.

- **`schemas/group-schema.json` (lines 1-43, verified firsthand):** the parallel-group manifest has NO per-job `repo` field — `jobs[]` items carry only `name`, `jobDir`, `branch`, `phase`, `dependsOn`, `status` (lines 32-39). Group-level `baseBranch` (L18), `integrationBranch` (L19), `prUrl` (L20), `prCreatedAt` (L21) are all SINGLE-target. This is why parallel-ralph cannot finalize across repos.
- **`skills/decompose-plan/SKILL.md` (verified firsthand):** Step 1 repo-root detection (≈L105-118) resolves ONE `repo_root` via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`; member worktrees are all created from that one root (≈L172-193). The batch PRD conversion at Step 5e (L209-221) calls `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch --branch ... --worktree-path ... --start-point ... --job-dir ... --group-name ... --group-dir ...` and **does NOT pass `--target-repo`** — so every member `repoDir` == the single detected root. This is the exact gap.
- **`skills/convert-to-ralph-prd/SKILL.md` (verified firsthand):** `--batch` (L23) requires `--branch` (L24), `--worktree-path` (L25), `--job-dir` (L27); `--target-repo` (L32, override branch L265-281) skips the repo-detector Explore agent and is the authoritative source of `target_repo`/`repoDir`. CRITICAL FINDING: **`--job-dir` is fully DECOUPLED from `--target-repo`** — the job tracking dir can live anywhere (e.g. a central wrapper `.ralph/jobs/`) while the worktree + commits land in a different `--target-repo`. This resolves the brainstorm's "job-dir-placement" disconfirming concern. `repoDir` is the ONE writable repo; `additionalDirs[]` (L123) are read-only `--add-dir` context dirs.
- **`src/worktree-create.mjs` (verified):** already accepts `--target-repo` (arg parse L157-159) and `--init-submodules` (L172-174, default OFF since v5.50.0); uses `targetRepo` as the git cwd for `git worktree add`. Handles branch/path collisions with numeric suffixes; accepts `--start-point` (so per-repo base branches like `sandbox-patches` vs `main` are expressible).
- **`skills/implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md` (verified):**
  - L215-224: **`--target-repo` × `--parallel` hard rejection** (fail-fast before `decompose-plan`). This guard MUST be preserved.
  - L1533-1625: **Phase 6 "Lead handoff for submodule ship"** — when `prd.json.repoDir` is a submodule of the wrapper repo, detection derives the wrapper root from `job_dir/../../..`, runs `git -C <wrapper> submodule status -- <relative_repoDir>`, and if non-empty emits the 7-step ceremony prose to stdout + `progress.txt`. It is a MANUAL handoff, NOT automation. This is the per-job ship surface the new ship-order manifest references.
- **`scripts/codex-lowering.mjs` + `scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs`:** codex skill bodies are GENERATED (not hand-forked) from `skills/*/SKILL.md` via a lowering pass (`Agent(` → native `spawn_agent` recipes; `CODEX_FORBIDDEN` token gate; `AGENT_SITE_INVENTORY`/`PROSE_SITE_INVENTORY` drift guards). Mirrors regenerate via `node plugins/ralph/scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --target=all --write`; check via `--check`. **codex loads a skill body only when the prompt carries a `$ralph-orchestration:<skill>` namespaced mention (the `$` sigil) — a bare `/slash` is inert prose for a codex member** (this is precisely why the 2026-06-09 codex member hand-rolled). The exact registered token must be verified via a codex skill-list probe at impl time.
- **`src/path-utils.mjs`:** `detectRepoRoot` (≈L57-73) anchors `.ralph/jobs` resolution (`resolveJobsBase` ≈L45-47) on `prd.json.repoDir`; auto-detection picks the job dir under a repo's `.ralph/jobs`. Explicit `--job-dir` overrides this — the basis for central job-dir placement.
- **Tests:** `tests/run.mjs` auto-discovers `test-*.mjs` (node:test); some legacy `*.sh` tests need Git Bash. Existing relevant coverage: `tests/test-target-repo-override.mjs`, `tests/test-decompose-plan-schema.sh`, `tests/test-decompose-plan-suggested-decomposition.sh`, `tests/worktree-create.test.mjs`, `tests/test-codex-generator.mjs`. New files under `plugins/ralph/lib/` need `git add -f` (broad `lib/` gitignore); `src/` is fine.
- **Version stamps:** ralph is at **v5.60.0**. Six stamps move in lockstep: `plugins/ralph/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `plugins/ralph/.github/plugin/plugin.json`, `plugins/ralph/.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, `.github/plugin/marketplace.json`, `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` (+ `CHANGELOG.md`, `AGENTS.md`). Use the repo-level `/release-plugin ralph <ver>` skill for the bump.

### Increment-2 frequency-gate result (the brainstorm's GO/defer decision)
Computed over all 144 shipped-with-commits tasks (of 312) in `.ralph-overview/data.json` + `.ralph-overview/data.archived.json`, classifying by `shipManifest.commits[].repo`:
- **Genuine 2+ repo SUBSTANTIVE write (both repos get non-pointer-bump commits): 57.**
- Submodule code-write + pointer-bump-only parent (parent commit is the lead gitlink bump, already served by single-repo impl + lead bump): 36.
- Single-repo: 51.
- ~14 of the last 30 ships are multi-repo writes.

**Verdict: the brainstorm's disconfirming condition ("if truly-multi-repo plans are rare, ship Increment 1 and defer Increment 2") is FALSE.** Genuine multi-repo writes recur frequently → Increment 2 is justified (still staged after Increment 1). **The dominant beneficiary is the codex NESTED two-repo case** (`codex-patched` inner crate off branch `sandbox-patches` + `codex` wrapper docs `docs/implementation/patch-surface.md` off `main`) — e.g. codex-anthropic-model-persists, codex-autoconnect-interactive-self-onboard, codex-hook-executor-windows-native-shell, the entire 2026-06-11/12 TUI batch, and the codex upstream rebases. The simpler `ai-developer-toolkit + codexu` pairs are MOSTLY the pointer-bump category. Detail: `.ralph/jobs/.staging/<sid>/frequency-check.md` (moved to the job dir on finalize).

### Technical Constraints
- **Cross-engine:** the per-repo template + generated scaffolder skill MUST work for a codex member specifically. The spawn command emitted per job MUST use the `$ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph` namespaced mention (not `/`). Any new skill must pass the codex lowering pass (no `CODEX_FORBIDDEN` tokens; register in `AGENT_SITE_INVENTORY`/`PROSE_SITE_INVENTORY` if it adds `Agent(`/prose-delegation sites) and the Codex Release Gate.
- **Irreversible-surface boundary:** the plugin MUST NOT automate cross-repo pushes, submodule-pointer bumps, multi-remote pushes, or cross-repo rollback. Those stay the lead-owned ceremony; the scaffolder only EMITS a checklist that references it.
- **Codex nested topology gotcha:** the Phase 6 auto submodule-ship handoff detection (`git -C <wrapper> submodule status -- <relative_repoDir>`) detects a DIRECT submodule of the wrapper. `codex-patched` is a submodule-OF-a-submodule (codexu → codex → external/repos/codex-patched), so the auto-detection does NOT fire for the inner crate from codexu. The ship-order manifest (Increment 2) is therefore the source of truth for the codex nested case — its gates are written explicitly, not inferred. Increment 1's standalone template + validator already cover this case manually.
- **Preserve existing behavior:** the `--target-repo` × `--parallel` rejection (implement-with-ralph L215-224) and the decompose-plan/parallel-ralph group machinery stay UNCHANGED. The scaffolder emits INDEPENDENT `.ralph/jobs/<slug>` seeds + a standalone manifest; it does NOT touch `group-schema.json` (settled — see Open Questions).

## Approach

### Architecture
Two independent, additive layers; neither modifies the parallel-group scheduler:

1. **Increment 1 — convention + safety net (no flow change):**
   - A new standalone Node CLI `src/validate-prd-scope.mjs` (ESM, `main(argv)` + auto-run, exit `0` OK / `1` IO-error / `2` cross-repo write). Its PRIMARY proof is a machine-readable per-job `writeScope` (an array of repo-rooted writable paths the scaffolder emits from the repo-map assignments and writes into the seed's `prd.json` / a sidecar): the validator asserts every `writeScope` path resolves under the single `repoDir`, and that any other mapped repo appears only in `additionalDirs[]` (read-only). PRD/plan **prose path-scanning is a SECONDARY warning layer** (catches obvious leaks but is heuristic — see Risk Areas). Hard exit `2` on a structured cross-repo write. (Per review F-006: prose alone cannot enforce the invariant when stories omit paths; the structured `writeScope` is the load-bearing input.)
   - A canonical per-repo job TEMPLATE + spawn-prompt CONVENTION, documented in a new `docs/multi-repo-split.md`, referenced from `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md` and one cross-ref line in `implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md`. The convention REQUIRES: (a) one scoped per-repo plan/PRD per repo (`--target-repo` + `--job-dir`, other repos as read-only `additionalDirs`), (b) the `$ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph` namespaced spawn mention (NOT `/`) with scope encoded in the PRD (NOT prose "Job 1 only" prohibitions), (c) running `validate-prd-scope.mjs` on each seed before spawn. **The codexu wrapper `AGENTS.md` "Dual-repo plans" bullet update is a LEAD-owned wrapper step (it edits a repo OUTSIDE the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule target), NOT an impl story** — see "Lead-owned cross-repo ship steps" below (review F-004).

2. **Increment 2 — the scaffolder (artifact generation, lead-gated ship):**
   - A new executable CLI `src/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs` (the load-bearing logic, exercised by `node:test`) plus a thin user-invocable wrapper skill `skills/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs/SKILL.md`. A markdown skill alone is NOT testable by `tests/run.mjs` and risks re-creating the hand-roll failure (review F-001), so the deterministic generation lives in the `.mjs`. Given ONE plan.md + a machine-readable repo map, per repo cluster the CLI: creates a worktree in that repo via `worktree-create.mjs --target-repo <repo> --start-point <per-repo-base-branch> --branch ralph/<plan>-<repo-slug>`, writes a scoped per-repo plan excerpt, calls `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch --target-repo <repo> --job-dir <central-job-dir> --worktree-path <wt> --branch <br>` to emit a scoped single-repo `prd.json` (repoDir = that repo), then **post-processes the generated `prd.json` to inject `additionalDirs[]`** (the other repos, for read context) and the structured `writeScope` — because `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch` has NO flag to set `additionalDirs` (it is an interactive Step-6 question, skipped in batch — review F-002). It then runs `validate-prd-scope.mjs` as a HARD gate on each seed.
   - It emits a standalone **ship-order manifest** `<plan-dir>/ship-order-manifest.json` (new `schemas/ship-order-manifest-schema.json`): jobs in dependency/ship order, each with `{ repoName, repoDir, jobDir, runCommand, shipGate }`. **The `runCommand` is `$ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph --run-only --job <jobDir> --autonomous`** — NOT `--from-plan`, because `--from-plan` re-runs Phase 0→2 (`convert-to-ralph-prd`) and would OVERWRITE the pre-seeded, validator-approved `prd.json`; `--run-only` skips planning and executes the existing seed (review F-003; impl must verify `--run-only` executes stories on a fresh pre-seeded job). `shipGate` is an explicit ORDERED step list (see codex-nested sequence below), not a single string. The manifest references (does not re-implement) the canonical 7-step ceremony in `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md`. It is a CHECKPOINT LIST, not a saga ledger — NO state-machine/rollback. The scaffolder also records the manifest path into each generated job's `prd.json`/`notepad.md` for lead discoverability via `list-jobs` (review F-010).
   - Repo-map input shape: a dedicated `schemas/repo-map-schema.json` JSON file passed via `--repo-map <path>`: `{ "repos": { "<name>": "<abspath>" }, "assignments": [ { "repo": "<name>", "baseBranch": "<branch>", "stories": ["US-001"], "writeScope": ["<path>"], "shipOrder": 1 } ] }`. Repo selection + write paths are NEVER inferred from prose. (CLI `--repo name=path` is supported as a convenience overlay but assignments/shipOrder/writeScope must be explicit.)

**Stage A — Increment 1 (Ralph job 1, ship as v5.61.0, dogfood, THEN start Increment 2):**

2. `US-002` — `docs/multi-repo-split.md` template + `$namespaced` spawn convention; `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md` section; one cross-ref line in `implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md`. (Submodule-only; NO codexu wrapper edits here — those are lead-owned, below.)
3. `US-003` — regenerate copilot + codex mirrors (`generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --target=all --write`) for the SKILL.md cross-ref; `CHANGELOG.md`; six version stamps → v5.61.0.

**Lead-owned cross-repo ship steps (after Job 1 commits in the submodule — NOT impl stories, review F-004 3-way consensus):**
- FF-merge the submodule topic branch; push `ai-developer-toolkit` to all submodule remotes; bump the codexu `ai-developer-toolkit` pointer; **update the codexu root `AGENTS.md` active-plugin-versions table to ralph 5.61.0 in the SAME commit as the pointer bump** (CI invariant); update the codexu `AGENTS.md` "Dual-repo plans don't chain into /implement-with-ralph blindly" bullet to point at `docs/multi-repo-split.md`; push codexu remotes; `copilot plugin update`. This is the existing 7-step ceremony in `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md` — the feature's OWN multi-repo split applied to itself.

**Stage B — Increment 2 (Ralph job 2, ship as v5.62.0):**
4. `US-004` — `schemas/repo-map-schema.json` + `schemas/ship-order-manifest-schema.json`.
5. `US-005` — `src/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs` CLI (reads plan + repo-map; per-repo worktree via `worktree-create --target-repo --start-point`; per-repo `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch`; post-process `prd.json` to inject `additionalDirs[]` + `writeScope`; `validate-prd-scope.mjs` hard gate; emits ship-order manifest with `--run-only` run commands; records manifest path in each seed for discoverability) + thin `skills/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs/SKILL.md` wrapper (cross-engine-clean prose).
6. `US-006` — codex nested-topology support: honor per-assignment `baseBranch` (`--start-point`) and arbitrary nesting depth; encode the EXACT ordered codex nested ship sequence in the manifest (member inner-worktree push → inner SHA reachable on `sandbox-patches` → canonical inner FF → wrapper docs/gitlink commit on `main` → push wrapper remotes); document that Phase 6 auto-detection does NOT fire for submodule-of-submodule so the manifest is the source of truth.
7. `US-007` — tests: scaffolder fixture (2-repo split → 2 valid scoped `prd.json` + manifest, each passing the validator), codex nested fixture, validator-as-gate integration, schema-validation of emitted repo-map + manifest, and a `git push`/pointer-bump/rollback-absence assertion via mocked `execFileSync`. (dependsOn US-005 AND US-006.)
8. `US-008` — register the new skill in `generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs` AND update `AGENT_SITE_INVENTORY`/`PROSE_SITE_INVENTORY` if it adds any `Agent(`/prose-delegation sites (the Codex generator test FAILS on inventory drift otherwise); regenerate copilot + codex mirrors; Codex + Copilot Release Gates green; `CHANGELOG.md`; `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md` (document the scaffolder + UNCHANGED ship ceremony); six version stamps → v5.62.0. (Lead ship steps for Job 2 mirror the Job-1 ceremony: pointer bump + active-plugin-versions table → ralph 5.62.0.)

## Scope

### In Scope
- Increment 1: `validate-prd-scope.mjs` (structured `writeScope`-primary) + per-repo template/convention + `$namespaced` spawn requirement + submodule docs.
- Increment 2: `scaffold-multi-repo-jobs` CLI + thin skill emitting N scoped single-repo job seeds + a dependency-ordered ship-order manifest; repo-map + manifest schemas; codex nested topology support; copilot/codex mirrors; tests; version bumps.
- Keeping the cross-repo SHIP entirely lead-gated and referencing the canonical 7-step ceremony. The codexu wrapper edits (pointer bump, active-plugin-versions table, "Dual-repo plans" bullet) are lead-owned ship steps, not impl-job stories.

### Out of Scope (explicitly)
- D-002: automated cross-repo submodule-pointer bumps, multi-remote pushes, cross-repo PR creation, cross-repo rollback/partial-failure recovery. (Devil's-advocate red-flagged; remains the lead ceremony.)
- Reworking `parallel-ralph` Phase 5 finalization / `prelaunch-merge-job` / `group-schema.json` for per-repo integration branches. (Independent seeds + manifest is preferred — see Open Questions.)
- Any change to the existing `--target-repo` × `--parallel` rejection.
- Promising an "atomic single multi-repo job." Product copy says "split & sequence a multi-repo plan."

## Risk Areas
- **Writable-path validation depth (review F-006).** `validate-prd-scope.mjs`'s LOAD-BEARING input is the structured per-job `writeScope` the scaffolder emits from the repo-map; prose path-scanning of PRD criteria / plan "Files to Create/Modify" is a SECONDARY warning layer (catches obvious leaks but is heuristic — a story that names no files can pass the prose layer). Mitigation: require the structured `writeScope` for the hard gate; validate the structural `repoDir`/`additionalDirs` invariant (a writable path under an `additionalDirs`-only repo → fail); document the prose layer's limits. For the manual Increment-1 template (no scaffolder), the lead supplies the writeScope or accepts the prose-only best-effort check.
- **Pre-seeded PRD overwrite (review F-003).** The scaffolder pre-generates + validates `prd.json` seeds; launching them with `--from-plan` would re-run Phase 2 PRD-gen and OVERWRITE the approved seed. The manifest run command MUST be `--run-only --job <jobDir> --autonomous`. Impl must verify `--run-only` executes stories on a fresh pre-seeded job (Phase 2R routes by on-disk state).
- **Codex nested submodule-of-submodule** (`codex-patched`) is the dominant case but the HARDEST topology: Phase 6 auto submodule-ship detection (`git -C <wrapper> submodule status -- <relative_repoDir>`) does NOT fire for a submodule-of-a-submodule, and codex members set up the nested inner as a worktree-local git dir requiring a `git push origin HEAD:sandbox-patches` from the member worktree inner before the canonical-inner FF (codexu memory). The manifest must encode the EXACT ordered sequence (inner-worktree push → inner SHA reachable on `sandbox-patches` → canonical inner FF → wrapper docs/gitlink commit on `main` → push wrapper remotes); do NOT rely on auto-detection.
- **Codex skill-mention token correctness (review F-012).** Asserting the generated run command merely CONTAINS `$ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph` is not sufficient — the token could be wrong and still pass while codex hand-rolls. The impl must verify the exact registered token via a codex skill-list/registry probe and capture that evidence (AC6).
- **Story→repo assignment ambiguity.** If a story touches files in two repos it cannot be cleanly assigned; the validator rejects it, forcing the planner to split the story per repo first. Document this as the required pre-condition.
- **Manifest staleness.** If plan-review changes stories after the manifest is generated, the manifest goes stale. Mitigation: the scaffolder is re-runnable and overwrites the manifest; document "regenerate after any plan/story change."
- **Mirror/release-gate drift.** Adding a skill requires registering it in the generator, updating the lowering inventories if it adds delegation sites, and passing the Codex + Copilot Release Gates; forgetting yields silent mirror omission or a generator-test failure. Covered by US-008 + the existing `--check` gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `node plugins/ralph/src/validate-prd-scope.mjs --prd <single-repo-prd.json>` exits `0`; against a fixture seed whose structured `writeScope` (or, secondarily, a story) names a path under a repo listed only in `additionalDirs`, it exits `2` with a diagnostic naming the offending path + repo; a malformed/missing PRD exits `1`. The structured `writeScope` is the load-bearing input; prose path-scan is a secondary warning. (Verify: `tests/test-validate-prd-scope.mjs` green via `node plugins/ralph/tests/run.mjs`.)

## Preliminary Story Decomposition
- **US-001 (Inc1):** `src/validate-prd-scope.mjs` scope validator (structured `writeScope`-primary, prose-secondary) + node:test. (AC1)
- **US-002 (Inc1):** per-repo template + `$namespaced` spawn convention docs — `docs/multi-repo-split.md`, `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md`, `implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md` cross-ref. (AC2) NOTE: codexu wrapper edits are NOT in this story — they are lead-owned ship steps.
- **US-003 (Inc1):** mirror regen + CHANGELOG + six-stamp v5.61.0 bump. (AC3) — dependsOn US-001, US-002.
- **US-004 (Inc2):** `repo-map-schema.json` + `ship-order-manifest-schema.json`. (AC5) — dependsOn US-003.
- **US-005 (Inc2):** `src/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs` CLI (per-repo worktree via worktree-create --target-repo --start-point; convert-to-ralph-prd --batch; post-process prd.json for additionalDirs + writeScope; validator hard gate; manifest emission with --run-only run commands + discoverability hook) + thin `skills/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs/SKILL.md` wrapper. (AC4, AC5, AC7) — dependsOn US-004.
- **US-006 (Inc2):** codex nested-topology support (per-assignment baseBranch / --start-point; manifest-explicit ORDERED inner ship sequence). (AC6) — dependsOn US-005.
- **US-007 (Inc2):** scaffolder + nested-topology + validator-gate + schema-validation + no-cross-repo-push (mocked execFileSync) tests. (AC4, AC6, AC7) — dependsOn US-005 AND US-006.
- **US-008 (Inc2):** register skill in generator (+ inventory update if delegation sites added), regen mirrors, Release Gates, CHANGELOG, AGENTS.md, six-stamp v5.62.0 bump. (AC8) — dependsOn US-005, US-006, US-007.

## Suggested Decomposition
All stories touch the SAME plugin (`ralph`) and share version-stamp/CHANGELOG/AGENTS.md files, so cross-story parallelism is unsafe (same-plugin version-file + doc conflicts). Recommend SERIAL execution in two phases mirroring the two ship increments.

### Cluster: increment-1-splitter-foundation
- Stories: US-001, US-002, US-003
- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`plugins/ralph/CHANGELOG.md`, six version stamps, `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md`]; exclusive=[`src/validate-prd-scope.mjs`, `tests/test-validate-prd-scope.mjs`, `docs/multi-repo-split.md`]; risk=medium (shared version/doc files force serial)
- `execution_mode` rationale: serial — the three stories converge on the same version-stamp/CHANGELOG/mirror files; they must run in order and ship as one version (v5.61.0).

### Cluster: increment-2-scaffolder
- Stories: US-004, US-005, US-006, US-007, US-008
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: increment-1-splitter-foundation
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`plugins/ralph/CHANGELOG.md`, six version stamps, `plugins/ralph/AGENTS.md`, `scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs`]; exclusive=[`skills/scaffold-multi-repo-jobs/SKILL.md`, the two schemas, `tests/test-scaffold-multi-repo-jobs.mjs`]; risk=high (depends on Inc1's validator + ships its own version)
- `execution_mode` rationale: serial, after Increment 1 ships — the scaffolder hard-gates on `validate-prd-scope.mjs` (US-001) and the convention docs (US-002), and converges on the same version/doc files; ships as v5.62.0.

Parallel handoff: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <plan_job_dir>/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition <plan_job_dir>/suggested-decomposition.json` (NOTE: the two clusters are strictly serial/dependent; parallelism yields no speed-up here — serial `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan <plan_job_dir>/plan.md` is the recommended path).

## Open Questions
- **Settled — independent seeds + manifest vs group.json reuse:** this plan chooses INDEPENDENT `.ralph/jobs/<slug>` seeds + a standalone ship-order manifest and does NOT add a per-job `repo` field to `group-schema.json`. Rationale (brainstorm synthesis + architect lens + verified schema): `group.json`'s `dependsOn` is EXECUTION ordering, not cross-repo RELEASE ordering; conflating them would force `parallel-ralph` Phase 5 single-target finalization to become multi-target (XL, irreversible-surface blast radius). The task-seed line suggesting a `group-schema.json` per-job `repo` field is intentionally NOT taken; the selected-direction's stronger recommendation wins. Re-open only if a future need for unified multi-repo parallel EXECUTION (not just ship) emerges.
- **Settled — job-dir placement:** generated job dirs live centrally under the orchestrating wrapper's `.ralph/jobs/<plan>-<repo-slug>/` (one place for the lead to see the whole multi-repo plan + manifest), while each worktree/commit lands in its `--target-repo`. Enabled by `convert-to-ralph-prd --batch`'s decoupled `--job-dir`. (Alternative — job dir under each target repo — was considered; central wins for lead visibility and because a submodule's `.ralph/jobs` is gitignored/awkward.)
- **Open — validator input granularity:** the load-bearing input is the structured `writeScope` (scaffolder-emitted from the repo-map); whether the prose-secondary layer also parses `plan.md` "Files to Create/Modify" (richer than PRD criteria) or PRD-only is an impl tuning choice. Plan recommends `writeScope` primary + PRD prose secondary + optional `--plan`. [INFERRED default.]
- **Open — exact codex skill-mention token:** the run command uses `$ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph`; the impl MUST verify the exact registered token via a codex skill-list/registry probe and capture that as AC6 evidence (a string-contains assertion is insufficient — review F-012). Codex mention syntax has drifted across releases.
- **Resolved by review — cross-repo codexu edits are lead-owned ship steps,** not impl-job stories, because a Ralph job has one `repoDir` (the submodule); the impl cannot edit the codexu wrapper without violating the one-repo constraint the feature adds. The pointer bump + active-plugin-versions table + "Dual-repo plans" bullet move during the ship ceremony.
- **Open — frequency-gate already answered GO**, but the operator may still choose to ship ONLY Increment 1 first and re-evaluate Increment 2 after dogfooding (the plan supports stopping after Stage A).

## Next Step
Implement as **TWO separate Ralph jobs** (an autonomous `--from-plan` run will not pause between increments for the Increment-1 ship + dogfood):

1. **Increment 1 (Ralph job 1 → ship v5.61.0):**
   Skill("ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph", args="--from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-orchestration-multi-repo-single-job-support/plan.md --autonomous")
   scoped to US-001..US-003 (the impl member commits in the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule). The lead then runs the wrapper ship steps (submodule FF + push + codexu pointer bump + active-plugin-versions table → ralph 5.61.0 + "Dual-repo plans" bullet) and DOGFOODS the splitter on the next real dual-repo task (replay the 2026-06-09 codex scenario).
2. **Increment 2 (Ralph job 2 → ship v5.62.0):** after Increment 1 is shipped + dogfooded, implement US-004..US-008.

Because the two clusters are strictly serial and the second depends on the first being shipped, prefer two sequential single-repo jobs over `--parallel` (parallel yields no speed-up here). The impl member must create its worktree INSIDE the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule and use the two-commit submodule flow; do NOT `git add` the codexu root `CLAUDE.md` (gitignored).

After merging each increment's plan branch, clean up with `/plan-with-ralph cleanup ralph-orchestration-multi-repo-single-job-support`.
